Frequently Asked Questions
Does the C1200 Gold support 12V-2x6 graphics cards?
Yes. The C1200 Gold includes one 16-pin (12+4) 12V-2x6 PCIe cable and three 6+2-pin PCIe cables, each 650 mm long. The C1200 Gold is an ATX 3.1 power supply, compliant with ATX12V v3.1 and EPS12V v2.92.
Does the C1200 Gold have a zero RPM fan mode?
Yes. The C1200 Gold has a Zero RPM Fan Mode that keeps its 135 mm fluid dynamic bearing fan stopped until system load reaches 50%. A button on the power supply turns the mode off if you want the fan spinning all the time.
How efficient is the C1200 Gold?
The C1200 Gold is rated 80 PLUS Gold. At 115 V, efficiency measures 90.1% at 20% load, 91.6% at 50% load and 88.7% at full load. Total output is 1200 W, with up to 100 A available on the +12V rail.
Is the C1200 Gold fully modular, and what cables are included?
Yes, the C1200 Gold is fully modular. The box includes a 600 mm 24-pin ATX cable, 700 mm 4+4-pin and 8-pin CPU cables, three SATA cables with 12 SATA connectors in total, a peripherals cable with 4 connectors and an AC power cord.
How big is the C1200 Gold, and what warranty does it have?
The C1200 Gold measures 150 x 86 x 160 mm (W x H x D) in a standard ATX form factor and comes in white or black. NZXT covers the C1200 Gold with a 10-year warranty.
